words.label: NEW THIS YEAR
words.body:
*A second TwinkleTown* will open in *St Patrick’s Park in the Liberties*, featuring Christmas lighting, themed carousels and choral performances.

Dublin’s *Winter Lights* programme will also return in December, with festive projections and installations at locations including the *GPO and City Hall*.
words.details: *And this year, the lights will stay up into January.*
